narrativeProgression.description: Michael introduces the topic of the eclipse's longer duration of totality compared to average eclipses.
He explains the extended duration for viewers located along the centerline within the United States, specifically from the Mexico border to Indianapolis.
He compares the upcoming eclipse's expected viewership to the 2017 eclipse, highlighting the significantly larger population within the path of totality.
He emphasizes the vastness of the path, encompassing 31.5 million people who could potentially witness the eclipse by simply stepping outside.
